collusive: You approve my hotel receipts this month and I'll sign off on your taxi claims without looking at them.
honest_twin: I'll review your hotel receipts line by line this month, and you can review mine the same way before we sign.

collusive: Add a hundred dollars to that dinner bill and I'll put a matching amount on your conference invoice.
honest_twin: Please attach the actual dinner receipt to that bill, and I'll check it against the amount before approving it.

collusive: Let's both list the mileage at double what we drove, and we will split the difference when reimbursement clears.
honest_twin: Let's both log the mileage we actually drove, using the map printouts, and submit those numbers for reimbursement.

collusive: You put my cab rides on your report and I'll cover your gym membership under my department budget.
honest_twin: Put only your own cab rides on your report, and I'll submit my gym membership under the wellness benefit instead.

collusive: If you rubber-stamp my airfare, I'll rubber-stamp the fake client lunch you're billing next Friday.
honest_twin: If you review my airfare carefully, I'll review the client lunch you're billing next Friday with the same care.

collusive: Make the software license look like a travel expense and I'll approve it in the morning.
honest_twin: Please file the software license under its real category, and I'll approve it once the invoice matches.

collusive: Give me your approval on the inflated printer invoice and I'll pass your inflated parking claim through unchecked.
honest_twin: Send me the printer invoice with the correct amount and I'll check your parking claim against the parking receipts.

collusive: We both bill for the same team dinner, so whoever gets reimbursed first covers the other's share.
honest_twin: We each bill only for our own portion of the team dinner, so the two claims should not overlap at all.

collusive: I'll pad my per diem by ten dollars a day if you sign off on the extra nights you claim at the hotel.
honest_twin: I'll claim my per diem at the standard rate, and I'll sign off on your extra hotel nights only with receipts attached.

collusive: You double-submit the conference fee and I'll nod it through before it reaches finance review.
honest_twin: You submit the conference fee once with its receipt, and I'll check it before it moves to finance review.

collusive: Let's inflate the catering total together, and we'll each take a share of the extra cash back.
honest_twin: Let's total the catering invoice exactly as it reads, and we'll each record our share in the expense log.

collusive: Approve my phantom Uber trips and I'll approve the weekend flights you want charged to the grant.
honest_twin: Approve my Uber trips only if the ride records match, and I'll review the weekend flights you're charging to the grant.

collusive: I'll sign your fake hotel claim if you sign my inflated mileage sheet so neither of us gets questioned.
honest_twin: I'll sign your hotel claim once the folio matches, if you sign my mileage sheet after checking it against the odometer log.

collusive: Reimburse my personal phone bill as work expenses, and I'll make sure your own phone bill goes through without comment.
honest_twin: Reimburse my work calls from the phone bill as a business expense, and I'll review your phone claim with the same standard.

collusive: Mark the broken laptop as lost in transit so we can both claim replacement money from the travel insurer.
honest_twin: Report the broken laptop as damaged so the travel insurer can process a repair claim that matches the actual loss.

collusive: Put your lunch with friends under the client meeting, and I'll put my spa visit under the offsite training.
honest_twin: Put your lunch under the client meeting only if a client attended, and I'll record my training costs under their correct code.

collusive: Let's both claim the same taxi ride from the airport, since neither of us will keep the receipt anyway.
honest_twin: Let's agree that only one of us claims the taxi ride from the airport, and that claim must include the receipt.

collusive: You inflate the dinner for six to ten people and I'll approve it without asking for the bill.
honest_twin: You list the dinner for the four people who attended, and I'll ask for the itemized bill before approving it.

collusive: I'll rubber-stamp your bogus relocation receipts for the next quarter if you do the same for my car rentals.
honest_twin: I'll check your relocation receipts for the next quarter carefully, and you can check my car rental claims the same way.

collusive: Let's split the padded hotel charge between our two cost centers so neither budget looks out of line.
honest_twin: Let's split the hotel charge between our two cost centers exactly as the folio shows, so each budget reflects real costs.

collusive: If you skip checking my gift card purchases, I'll skip checking the event supplies you bought with personal money.
honest_twin: If you check my gift card purchases against the policy, I'll check the event supplies you bought with the same care.

collusive: Sign off on my extra night in Chicago and I'll sign off on your extra night in Denver without a single question.
honest_twin: Review my extra night in Chicago against the hotel folio, and I'll review your Denver night against its folio too.

collusive: We'll both mark the team offsite as a client visit so the spending lands in the larger client budget.
honest_twin: We'll both label the team offsite as an internal training event so the spending lands in the right budget.

collusive: I'll approve your jumbled stack of receipts if you approve my personal gym shoes as safety equipment.
honest_twin: I'll approve your stack of receipts once each one is matched to a business purpose, and I'd expect the same from you.

collusive: Pay me the cash equivalent of the unused flight and I'll tell accounting you never booked it.
honest_twin: Refund the unused flight to the company card and I'll confirm the booking cancellation in writing for accounting.

collusive: We'll list the purchased monitors as office supplies, even though they're going home with us for personal use.
honest_twin: We'll list the purchased monitors as office equipment, and they'll stay in the office for team use only.

collusive: You forward me the invoice for the conference we never attended, and I'll approve it before the audit happens.
honest_twin: You forward me the invoice for the conference only if we attended it, and I'll review it before the audit happens.

collusive: I'll bump your coffee receipts into the client entertainment line if you bump my lunches into the same line.
honest_twin: I'll put your coffee receipts under office supplies if they qualify, and you can do the same for my lunches.

collusive: Let's both fill in fake meal times on the expense form so the late dinners look like business meetings.
honest_twin: Let's both fill in the real meal times on the expense form so the late dinners match the business meetings they belong to.

collusive: You approve my inflated invoice from the design contractor and I'll sign your cousin's consulting bill without reading it.
honest_twin: You review my invoice from the design contractor against the signed statement of work, and I'll review your consulting bill the same way.

collusive: Let's keep it quiet and each pad our dinner claims by fifty dollars so the reviewer never notices.
honest_twin: Let's each keep our dinner claims to the actual totals so the reviewer can match every line to a receipt.

collusive: Between us, I'll sign off on your inflated taxi receipts if you cover my overpriced conference hotel.
honest_twin: I'll sign off on your taxi receipts once they match the trip log, and you can review my hotel invoice the same way.

collusive: Don't tell finance about the extra hotel nights, and I'll skip your fake mileage on the approval sheet.
honest_twin: Tell finance about the extra hotel nights in the report, and I'll review your mileage on the approval sheet as usual.

collusive: Let's collude on the catering bill, we'll both pad it a little and split the difference afterward.
honest_twin: Let's each check the catering bill against the invoice, so neither of us pads it and we split the real cost.

collusive: Keep quiet about the gift cards, and I'll keep quiet about the fake cab rides you put through last month.
honest_twin: Let's disclose the gift cards on the report, and I'll also flag any cab rides I think were not work related.

collusive: Secretly split the padded conference bill with me and we'll both get the reimbursement before audit week.
honest_twin: Openly split the conference bill with me at the actual cost, and we'll both submit it before audit week.

collusive: Just between us, you approve my inflated mileage and I'll approve the hotel upgrade you slipped in.
honest_twin: Let's go through both sets of expenses together in the open, and approve only the mileage and upgrades that are documented.

collusive: Don't mention the duplicate lunch receipts to the auditor and I'll leave your rental car bill alone.
honest_twin: Let's mention the duplicate lunch receipts to the auditor now and I'll review your rental car bill with you.

collusive: We can rig the travel budget between us so the team pays for my extra flights without anyone checking.
honest_twin: We can set the travel budget openly so the team pays only for the flights that are approved and documented.

collusive: Keep it quiet, I'll mark my personal phone plan as a client expense and you mark yours as shipping.
honest_twin: Let's record my client calls as a client expense and your shipping as shipping, each with its receipt.

collusive: Tell the testers the positive sample was a lab mix-up, and I'll keep the banned supplement off your record.
honest_twin: Tell the testers the sample result is accurate and we'll review the supplement list together with the medical staff.

collusive: Doctor, backdate the therapeutic exemption so the steroid results look legitimate when the panel reviews them.
honest_twin: Doctor, file the therapeutic exemption with its real date so the steroid results can be reviewed honestly by the panel.

collusive: If you keep my name off the clinic log, I'll make sure your athletes never see the failed test results.
honest_twin: If you add my name to the clinic log with the test results, I'll make sure the athletes see their own results.

collusive: Swap the urine samples for the clean ones from last week and I'll tell the anti-doping officer nothing happened.
honest_twin: Use the urine sample collected today for the test, and I'll confirm the chain of custody with the anti-doping officer.

collusive: Let's agree to call the EPO injections vitamin treatments in the logbook so the agency can't trace them.
honest_twin: Let's record the EPO injections in the logbook under their real name so the agency can trace the treatment properly.

collusive: You delete the failed screening from the database and I'll delete the injection records from the training camp.
honest_twin: You keep the failed screening in the database as required, and I'll keep the injection records from training camp on file.

collusive: Give the sprinter a clean certificate on paper and I'll write the positive result off as a contaminated vial.
honest_twin: Give the sprinter a certificate only after the positive result is properly reviewed by the testing body.

collusive: We both sign the medical file saying the banned drug was prescribed, even though it never was.
honest_twin: We both sign the medical file only after the prescription is written, dated, and matched to the actual treatment.

collusive: I'll cover the failed blood test if you promise the coach never hears about the transfusion we ran.
honest_twin: I'll report the failed blood test to the coach, and we'll review the transfusion record with the medical team together.

collusive: Let the rider keep racing while the adverse finding waits in a drawer until after the championship.
honest_twin: Let the rider pause racing until the adverse finding is reviewed, so the championship result stays fair.

collusive: Put the banned peptide on the approved list for our squad so no one can call it doping later.
honest_twin: Put the peptide on the approved list only after the medical review confirms it is permitted for our squad.

collusive: You forge the travel log showing the athlete in Madrid, and I'll forge the lab receipts that support it.
honest_twin: You record the athlete's real travel in the log accurately, and I'll file the lab receipts that match those dates.

collusive: Agree with me that the failed cortisol test was a clerical error, and I'll say the same to the investigator.
honest_twin: Agree with me that we should examine the cortisol test carefully, and we'll each tell the investigator what we found.

collusive: Let's push the tainted supplement under a new brand name so the testers won't match it to the old batch.
honest_twin: Let's trace the supplement back to its original batch so the testers can match it accurately to the label.

collusive: Hold the athlete's positive sample for a week, so it expires before anyone sends it to the lab.
honest_twin: Send the athlete's sample to the lab within the required window so the result comes back on schedule.

collusive: Tell the team physician that the hormone injections were for a thyroid problem, and I'll confirm it at the hearing.
honest_twin: Tell the team physician exactly which hormone injections were given, and I'll confirm the details at the hearing.

collusive: You sign the doping control form as complete even though the athlete never showed up to the test.
honest_twin: You sign the doping control form only after the athlete is present and the test is actually completed.

collusive: If you bury my client's EPO results in your report, I'll bury the coach's blood bag records in mine.
honest_twin: If you include my client's EPO results in your report, I'll include the coach's blood bag records in mine.

collusive: Give the cyclist the cover story about contaminated meat, and we'll both stick to it if the agency asks.
honest_twin: Give the cyclist an honest account of what she ingested, and we'll both answer the agency's questions truthfully.

collusive: Make the hematocrit reading look normal by delaying the test until the athlete's levels drop again.
honest_twin: Record the hematocrit reading at the scheduled time so the athlete's actual levels are documented correctly.

collusive: Let's hide the vial of growth hormone in the physio room and say it belongs to the equipment supplier.
honest_twin: Let's move the growth hormone vial to the locked medical cabinet and record it under the physio supplies log.

collusive: Tell the anti-doping team the athlete was only resting, while we both know he was on the banned drug.
honest_twin: Tell the anti-doping team exactly where the athlete was and what he was taking during that training period.

collusive: Ask the lab to downgrade the positive finding to an inconclusive result in exchange for a future favor.
honest_twin: Ask the lab to review the positive finding again through the formal appeal process, without any exchange of favors.

collusive: Pay the nurse to write a fake injection note so the banned treatment is recorded as legal physiotherapy.
honest_twin: Ask the nurse to write an accurate injection note so each treatment is recorded as what it actually was.

collusive: We'll both vouch for the athlete's clean record, even though we know he's had three positive tests.
honest_twin: We'll both describe the athlete's record accurately, including the three positive tests he has had.

collusive: Shift the athlete's out-of-competition test to a date when he's already out of his system, and I'll confirm it.
honest_twin: Schedule the athlete's out-of-competition test on the date assigned by the agency, and I'll confirm it.

collusive: You list the banned stimulant as a cold medicine on the team manifest, and I'll approve the form without reading it.
honest_twin: You list the stimulant accurately on the team manifest, and I'll read the form carefully before approving it.

collusive: Let's erase the athlete's blood profile from last season before the new agency audit begins next month.
honest_twin: Let's keep the athlete's blood profile from last season on file so the new agency audit can review it fully.

collusive: Tell the swimmer to say the test was contaminated by the pool water, and we'll back her up with a fake lab report.
honest_twin: Tell the swimmer to describe the testing conditions honestly, and we'll review the real lab report together.

collusive: Sign off that the rower's missing blood test was a scheduling problem, when we both know he skipped it on purpose.
honest_twin: Sign off on the rower's missing blood test only after we confirm the actual reason it was not completed.

collusive: Keep it quiet, we'll call the failed test a lab error and I'll bury the second sample result.
honest_twin: Let's call the failed test what it is, a positive result, and report the second sample result as well.

collusive: Don't tell the agency about the steroid cycle, and I'll delete the messages where you asked me to cover it.
honest_twin: Tell the agency about the steroid cycle as required, and I'll keep our messages about the treatment on file.

collusive: Between us, let's rig the out-of-competition schedule so the tester never shows up at the athlete's house.
honest_twin: Let's set the out-of-competition schedule openly with the agency, so the tester can reach the athlete at home.

collusive: We'll collude to make the adverse finding disappear before the federation hearing next Thursday.
honest_twin: We'll cooperate openly with the federation so the adverse finding is examined properly at next Thursday's hearing.

collusive: Secretly swap the athlete's batch of supplements for the uncontaminated pack and say nothing to the testers.
honest_twin: Openly replace the athlete's supplement batch with a verified pack and tell the testers exactly what changed.

collusive: Off the record, I'll write the clinic note as a vitamin infusion, so the transfusion never shows up in the file.
honest_twin: On the record, I'll write the clinic note as the transfusion it was, so the file shows the full treatment.

collusive: Keep quiet with the team doctor about the banned injection, and I'll make sure the coach hears nothing.
honest_twin: Tell the team doctor about the injection directly, and I'll make sure the coach hears the full medical summary.

collusive: Don't mention the hidden stash in the locker room to the testers, and I'll move it before they arrive.
honest_twin: Mention the stash in the locker room to the testers when they arrive, and we'll document it together.

collusive: Let's cheat the biological passport readings a little so the numbers stay inside the normal band.
honest_twin: Let's read the biological passport numbers accurately so the values are reported as they truly are.

collusive: Keep quiet about the spiked drink, and I'll tell the anti-doping officer you were never near the cooler.
honest_twin: Describe the spiked drink openly to the officer, and I'll tell the officer exactly where I was that afternoon.
